sync_xero.badge.title: Xero link
sync_xero.disconnect.anywayText: The stored connection cannot be read, so Open Mercato erases it without revoking it at Xero. Remove the app from the Organisation's Connected apps in Xero as well.
sync_xero.disconnect.description: Open Mercato erases its Xero access and asks Xero to revoke it. Syncing stops, and the Companies imported so far stay.
sync_xero.disconnect.disableSkipped: Xero is disconnected, but the integration stays enabled: disabling it needs the integrations.manage permission. Ask an administrator to disable it.
sync_xero.disconnect.doneWithoutRevoke: Disconnected. Open Mercato no longer holds Xero access.
sync_xero.disconnect.notConnected: There was no Xero connection to disconnect.
sync_xero.disconnect.otherOrganisations: This connection also covers: {names}. Revoking it may end their connection too.
sync_xero.disconnect.removeClientCredent: Also remove the Client ID and Secret
The Credentials tab is cleared, so connecting again needs them entered again.
sync_xero.disconnect.revocationFailed: Disconnected. Xero could not confirm the revocation, so remove the app from the Organisation's Connected apps in Xero.
sync_xero.disconnect.revokeReach: Xero ends every connection that this Xero user authorised for this Xero app, not only this one. Every Open Mercato organization connected that way must connect again.
sync_xero.disconnect.step.removeClientCr: removing the Client ID and Secret
sync_xero.disconnect.title: Disconnect Xero?

sync_xero.errors.connect_origin_rejected: Open Open Mercato from its configured address (APP_URL) to connect to Xero.

sync_xero.tab.unavailable.replaceText: The stored Xero connection cannot be decrypted. Connecting again replaces it. Open Mercato cannot revoke the old one, so remove the app from the Organisation's Connected apps in Xero if you no longer use it.
